title: When the Compass Burns
author: Ansel Joubert
blurb: Jonah Vasquez, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
